title: 🕰️ The Clockwork Quest Room
description: A state-driven escape-room quest about finding objects, learning rules, and opening the right exit.

nodes.label: Waking
text: You wake on a black-and-white marble floor inside a circular room. Brass ribs cross the ceiling like the inside of a clock 🕰️.
A sealed door waits opposite you. Above it, small letters read: The exit opens for the one who notices.

nodes.label: First Sense
text: The room is quiet except for water ticking 💧 somewhere behind stone. Five alcoves wait around the wall, each lit by a narrow lamp.
Your pockets are empty. Your memory offers only your name and the certainty that someone built this place to be solved.

nodes.label: Cold Door
nodes.text: The exit handle refuses to move. Three empty seals sit above it: one shaped like a mirror, one like a bell 🔔, and one like a drop of water.

nodes.label: No Answer
nodes.text: Your shout comes back too neatly. The echo is not natural; it arrives measured, clipped, and almost amused.

nodes.label: Hidden Tick
nodes.text: Under the silence, you hear three rhythms: a desk spring clicking, water counting seconds, and a bell humming without being struck 🔔.

nodes.label: Central Room
text: You stand at the center of the quest room. {{learnedMotto:The motto feels less like decoration and more like a rule. }}{{restoredPower:A warm current now moves through the floor. }}{{hasExitMap:The folded map in your pocket marks one route in red. }}
The alcoves wait: desk, mirror, basin, bells, orrery, and the sealed exit.

nodes.label: Rolltop Desk
text: The desk is walnut, old, and stubborn. Its rolltop is closed, but three scratches run across it like tally marks.
A carved sentence circles the keyhole: Begin where the room repeats itself.

nodes.label: Stuck Drawer
nodes.text: The drawers bite your fingers and refuse to open. Force answers nothing here, but the desk clicks when you stop fighting it.

nodes.label: Repeated Words
nodes.text: The scratches are not damage. They mark the repeated word in the room's motto: notice. The room wants observation before action.

nodes.label: Desk Chair
nodes.text: The chair is bolted down, but the leather cushion lifts at one corner. Something small taps wood beneath it when you press.

nodes.label: Brass Key
nodes.text: A tiny brass key 🗝️ drops into your palm. Its bow is shaped like an open eye, and its teeth are too delicate for the main exit.

nodes.label: Desk Return
nodes.text: The desk waits with theatrical patience. {{hasBrassKey:The brass key fits the small lock. }}{{learnedMotto:The word notice seems to tug your eye back to the keyhole. }}

nodes.label: Secret Drawer
nodes.text: The rolltop sighs upward. Inside are velvet channels, a silver tuning fork, and an index card written in a careful hand.

nodes.label: Ink Drawer
nodes.text: The side drawer opens without a key. It contains a corked vial of dark ink and a blotter stained with old circular marks.

nodes.label: Tuning Fork
nodes.text: The fork hums before you touch it to anything. One tine is marked high-low-high-low, a pattern too deliberate to be musical accident.

nodes.label: Bell Order
nodes.text: The card reads: Small bell hears the truth. Low bell carries it. Twin bells agree. Large bell ends the argument.

nodes.label: Dark Ink
nodes.text: The ink smells faintly of iron and oranges 🖋️. It clings to the glass as if it would rather become writing than stay liquid.

nodes.label: Blotter Map
nodes.text: Ink fills the old stains and reveals a tiny map of the room. One red line runs from the exit to a service crawl under the floor.

nodes.label: Desk Complete
nodes.text: The desk has given up what it knows. The room seems a little less silent now, as if a listener has leaned closer.

nodes.label: Mirror Wall
text: The mirror ✨ spans an entire alcove, but it reflects the room one second late. In the reflection, the exit door is slightly open.
A hairline crack runs from your reflected hand to the real frame.

nodes.label: Mirror Shard
nodes.text: A silver splinter comes free. It is sharp enough to cut cloth and bright enough to throw a thin blade of light across the room.

nodes.label: Fogged Glass
nodes.text: Your breath clouds the mirror. Letters rise in the mist, but the lamp behind you decides how much of them can be read.

nodes.label: Silver Frame
nodes.text: The frame is engraved with moons, closed eyes, and a notch just wide enough for a thin tool.

nodes.label: Lit Letters
nodes.text: In the warmed fog you read a number: 4173. Beneath it: The case opens only when the room can see itself.

nodes.label: Dim Letters
nodes.text: Only broken strokes appear before the fog fades. Whatever the mirror knows, it needs a warmer lamp before it will speak clearly.

nodes.label: Moon Lens
nodes.text: A crescent lens slips from the frame. When you look through it, the reflected room has labels where the real room has silence.

nodes.label: Safe Shard
nodes.text: You bind the shard in a torn strip from your cuff. It still gleams, but now it can be held without bleeding for every answer.

nodes.label: Mirror Center
nodes.text: The delayed reflection raises its hand only after you do. {{hasMoonLens:The moon lens makes hidden scratches glow around the glass. }}{{learnedNumberCode:The number 4173 stays bright in your memory. }}

nodes.label: Star Pattern
nodes.text: The shard reflects seven tiny stars onto the ceiling. Their order matches the frozen arms of the orrery across the room.

nodes.label: False Exit
nodes.text: The reflection mouths the motto backward: The obvious exit opens for escape. The true exit opens for understanding.

nodes.label: Behind Glass
nodes.text: Behind the mirror, something like a corridor wavers. It is not quite a place yet, only a promise made of silver light.

nodes.label: Lens Light
nodes.text: The moon lens settles into a hidden socket. A thread of pale light searches the room for a lamp strong enough to answer.

nodes.label: Hard Glass
nodes.text: The frame rings like a bell and sends a sting up your arm. The mirror does not like being hurried.

nodes.label: Moon Door
nodes.text: The lens catches lamplight and paints a small door in the reflection. Its handle is real only while the room has power.

nodes.label: Need Light
nodes.text: The socket accepts the lens, but the reflection stays dull. Somewhere in the room a lamp must be woken before this path matters.

nodes.label: Mirror Choice
nodes.text: The reflection shows two exits now: the real door and a silver corridor. One is physical. The other may be hunger wearing a hallway.

nodes.label: Silver Risk
nodes.text: You press your hand to the mirror. The surface gives like cold water, and the reflected room inhales.

nodes.label: Frame Mark
nodes.text: You scratch the frame with the shard. The reflection flinches after a delay, and the mark appears on both sides.

nodes.label: Thrown Back
nodes.text: The mirror spits you onto the marble floor. You keep your body, your fear, and the useful knowledge that the silver route is unfinished.

nodes.label: Water Basin
nodes.text: The basin is dry, though you still hear water ticking behind it 💧. Its rim is carved with twelve marks and one missing valve.

nodes.label: Water Clock
nodes.text: The ticking water pauses every fourth beat. The basin is not broken; it is waiting for the missing valve to match that rhythm.

nodes.label: Missing Valve
nodes.text: The valve stem is square, polished, and empty. A scratch beneath it points toward the shadow under the basin.

nodes.label: Dust Ripples
nodes.text: Your fingers brush the dry stone. Dust ripples outward as if stirred by invisible drops, then settles into twelve small rings.

nodes.label: Basin Rim
nodes.text: {{learnedWaterClock:The fourth-beat rhythm makes the valve marks readable. }}{{hasValveHandle:The handle is heavy enough to wake the dry mechanism. }}The basin waits for a choice.

nodes.label: Valve Handle
nodes.text: You find the handle magnetized beneath the basin. It snaps into your grip with the smug click of a thing hidden in plain sight.

nodes.label: Bent Key
nodes.text: The brass key can move the stem, but only badly. The mechanism groans, and the room answers with a disapproving tick.

nodes.label: Ink Rings
nodes.text: Ink races through the dry rings and writes 4173 around the rim. The same number belongs to the mirror's hidden case.

nodes.label: Basin Drains
nodes.text: The invisible water finally becomes visible for one breath, then drains away. A transparent glass key 🗝️ remains in the lowest cup.

nodes.label: Low Grate
nodes.text: A brass grate sits near the floor behind the basin. Through it you see chalk dust, a wire loop, and the edge of another tile.

nodes.label: Wet Numbers
nodes.text: The number stains the rim until you wipe it away. The ink has given you a code, but not yet told you where pride hides the lock.

nodes.label: White Chalk
nodes.text: Your fingers close around a chalk nub. It leaves marks even on polished brass, which feels like exactly why it was hidden.

nodes.label: Gear Timing
nodes.text: Behind the grate, two gears turn around an empty third space. Their teeth pause in the same seven-point rhythm the mirror hinted at.

nodes.label: Code Fixed
nodes.text: You repeat the digits until they settle: four, one, seven, three. The room gives no applause, but the number feels earned.

nodes.label: Dry Basin
nodes.text: The dry basin now shows a circular seam in the floor beside it. The glass key catches every lamp at once.

nodes.label: Floor Seam
nodes.text: The seam is not a crack. It is a hatch outline, nearly invisible unless the basin has been emptied first.

nodes.label: Empty Cup
nodes.text: You cup your hands, but the water has already vanished. The room allows lessons, not hoarding.

nodes.label: Trapdoor Mark
nodes.text: The floor seam is easy to lose when you look away. A chalk mark would keep it from vanishing into the marble pattern.

nodes.label: Marked Hatch
nodes.text: The chalk line settles around the hidden hatch. The center room will remember this option now, even if your eyes do not.

nodes.label: Basin Done
nodes.text: The basin returns to silence. It has taken a secret from the floor and given you a key made of clear light.

nodes.label: Bell Alcove
nodes.text: Four bells 🔔 hang in a row: small, low, twin, and large. None of them move, but all of them seem to be listening.

nodes.label: First Ring
nodes.text: You strike the large bell. The note rolls through the chamber and asks whether you brought the right tool.

nodes.label: Plaque Order
nodes.text: The plaques repeat the desk card's riddle. Truth starts small, grows low, agrees in twins, and ends large.

nodes.label: Fork Resonance
nodes.text: The tuning fork vibrates in sympathy and softens the wrong note. The bells forgive the mistake because you came prepared.

nodes.label: Painful Ring
nodes.text: The bell answers too loudly. Brass dust falls from the ceiling, and the room's patience grows thinner.

nodes.label: Four Bells
nodes.text: {{learnedBellOrder:The order is no longer a guess. }}{{hasTuningFork:The tuning fork hums in your pocket. }}The four bells wait for a sequence.

nodes.label: Correct Chime
nodes.text: Small, low, twin, large. The final note hangs in the room, and a brass panel opens beneath the bells.

nodes.label: Wrong Music
nodes.text: You invent an order. The bells tolerate invention poorly.

nodes.label: Bell Panel
nodes.text: Inside the panel lie a toothed sun gear and a thin warning plate wired to the wall.

nodes.label: Sour Echo
nodes.text: The bells clash and send a sour echo under the floor. Something below the marble knocks once in irritation.

nodes.label: Lost Minute
nodes.text: Nothing breaks, but the attempt costs time. The ticking water behind the basin sounds faster afterward.

nodes.label: Sun Gear
nodes.text: The sun gear ⚙️ is warm and dense. Its teeth are too specific for any mechanism except the frozen orrery.

nodes.label: Power Warning
nodes.text: The plate reads: Power wakes the room. Power also lets it decide what counts as an answer.

nodes.label: Music Memory
nodes.text: The bells are quiet again, but the opened panel has changed the alcove. A loose tile now sits beneath your left foot.

nodes.label: Seven Beats
nodes.text: The bell sequence becomes seven silent beats in your head. It matches the star pattern reflected by the mirror shard.

nodes.label: Loose Tile
nodes.text: The wall sounds hollow near the base. A square tile shifts, then settles as if embarrassed to have been caught.

nodes.label: Hidden Tile
nodes.text: The loose tile can be lifted, but its edges are narrow. Chalk marks already on the floor show where other solvers tried.

nodes.label: Copper Wire
nodes.text: Behind the tile you find a loop of copper wire, still flexible and clean. It looks like a bridge for a broken circuit.

nodes.label: Chalk Motto
nodes.text: Your chalk catches old grooves and reveals the motto again: Notice, name, answer, leave.

nodes.label: Bell Done
nodes.text: The bell alcove has become still. It has given you rhythm, metal, and a warning about waking the room too soon.

nodes.label: Orrery
nodes.text: A brass orrery ⚙️ fills the alcove. Its planets are frozen around an empty sun socket, and the crank hangs useless beside it.

nodes.label: Frozen Planets
nodes.text: The arms are locked at seven points. Without the missing sun gear, the whole machine is a beautiful refusal.

nodes.label: Gear Installed
nodes.text: The sun gear sinks into place. The orrery gives one grateful shiver, then waits for the correct pattern.

nodes.label: Planet Arms
nodes.text: The planets have tiny mirrored backs. If you had a lens or a pattern, the machine might tell you where each one belongs.

nodes.label: Crank Socket
nodes.text: {{gearInstalled:The sun gear is seated. }}{{learnedOrreryPattern:The seven-point pattern is clear now. }}{{hasCopperWire:The copper wire could close the broken circuit. }}

nodes.label: Lens Pattern
nodes.text: Through the moon lens, each planet wears a number of dots. Seven positions, seven beats, one order.

nodes.label: Bent Arm
nodes.text: The arm moves a finger-width and snaps back. The orrery is willing to be solved, not wrestled.

nodes.label: Orrery Whirs
nodes.text: You set the planets in order and turn the crank. The machine spins, testing whether its circuit is whole.

nodes.label: Circuit Bridge
nodes.text: The copper wire fits between two tired contacts. The orrery's lamp brightens from amber to steady gold.

nodes.label: Power Restored
nodes.text: Gold light ⚡ races through the floor channels. Lamps wake across the room, including one above the mirror.

nodes.label: Broken Circuit
nodes.text: The orrery spins once, sparks, and stops. It knows the pattern now, but its circuit cannot carry the answer.

nodes.label: Power Wakes
nodes.text: With power restored, the exit seals glow faintly. A glass case rises from the orrery base, asking for four digits.

nodes.label: Exit Glyphs
nodes.text: The glowing glyphs repeat the lesson from the mirror: escape is allowed, but understanding changes which door is real.

nodes.label: Glass Case
nodes.text: The case waits with four numbered wheels. The glass key in your pocket hums faintly near it.

nodes.label: Lit Chamber
nodes.text: Every lamp is awake now. The room has become easier to read and harder to ignore.

nodes.label: Crystal Star
nodes.text: The case opens around a small crystal star ⭐. It is cut to fit no lock you have seen, which makes it suspiciously important.

nodes.label: Wrong Key
nodes.text: The brass key scratches the case and achieves nothing. The room records the attempt with a small, judgmental click.

nodes.label: Lamp Warmed
nodes.text: The lamp above the mirror is already warm from the restored power. Its light is now part of the puzzle.

nodes.label: Shadow Order
nodes.text: The orrery casts three shadows on the exit: mirror first, bell second, water third. The door wants proof in that order.

nodes.label: Orrery Done
nodes.text: The orrery slows to a graceful stop. Its work is done, but the star in your hand still feels unfinished.

nodes.label: Exit Door
nodes.text: The exit door has three seals and one handle. The handle is plain iron, which almost makes it more threatening.

nodes.label: Handle Test
nodes.text: The handle tests the room's verdict before it tests your grip.

nodes.label: Three Locks
nodes.text: The mirror, bell, and water seals sit above the door. Each has a hollow center waiting for a different kind of proof.

nodes.label: Door Holds
nodes.text: The door does not open. It is not locked by strength, but by missing evidence 🔒.

nodes.label: Water Proof
nodes.text: The glass key melts into the water seal, then reforms in your hand. The door accepts the proof without stealing the tool.

nodes.label: Motto Spoken
nodes.text: You say, "Notice, name, answer, leave." The door warms, as if glad you learned the room's grammar.

nodes.label: Three Seals
nodes.text: {{mirrorSeal:The mirror seal glows. }}{{bellSeal:The bell seal glows. }}{{waterSeal:The water seal glows. }}The exit waits for all three proofs.

nodes.label: Mirror Proof
nodes.text: The mirror shard flashes silver and the first seal fills with reflected light.

nodes.label: Bell Proof
nodes.text: The memory of the correct chime travels through your fingers. The second seal answers in a clear, low note.

nodes.label: Water Proof
nodes.text: The drained-basin rhythm taps once behind the door. The third seal fills with blue-white light.

nodes.label: Door Judges
nodes.text: The three seals burn together. The door decides whether you solved enough to leave cleanly or merely found a way out.

nodes.label: Open Way
nodes.text: The door opens onto a narrow passage, exactly where the ink map promised. A smaller alcove glows beside the threshold.

nodes.label: Unmapped Way
nodes.text: The door opens, but the passage beyond is dark and cramped. You can leave, though you will not know what watched you go.

nodes.label: Locks Resist
nodes.text: The seals flare and fade. The door is not angry, only unconvinced.

nodes.label: Clue Review
nodes.text: You count what the room has taught you. Mirror, bell, water, power: the exit wants proof from each living system.

nodes.label: Force Door
nodes.text: You throw your shoulder into the door. The room allows the attempt, which is not the same as approving it.

nodes.label: Bruised Shoulder
nodes.text: The door wins. Your shoulder aches, and a line of brass numbers above the frame ticks downward.

nodes.label: Last Warning
nodes.text: The impact shakes dust from the ceiling. The room checks how much time you have left.

nodes.label: Mirror Prison
text: The reflection closes around you before the room has power enough to make it honest.
Outside the glass, another version of you lowers their hand one second too late.

nodes.label: Threshold
nodes.text: You step through the opened exit. The room exhales behind you, its clocks slowing 🕰️ as if a question has finally been answered.

nodes.label: Clean Escape
text: The passage delivers you to a quiet garden under dawn light.
You escaped the clockwork quest room with your mind intact and enough answers to know the door was never only a door.

nodes.label: Last Alcove
nodes.text: The small alcove contains a star-shaped socket ⭐ and a panel that breathes warm air through tiny holes.

nodes.label: Master Key
nodes.text: The crystal star unfolds into a master key made of seven interlocking pieces. It is less a key than an argument won.

nodes.label: Room Voice
nodes.text: Through the panel, a dry voice whispers, "Most leave. Few ask who built the leaving."

nodes.label: Awake Room
nodes.text: The alcove is no longer pretending to be furniture. It is an ear, a lock, and perhaps a witness.

nodes.label: Bargain Test
nodes.text: You offer the room a trade: truth for passage. It weighs what you have actually understood, not just what you have touched.

nodes.label: Refused Ear
nodes.text: You refuse to bargain with architecture. The alcove closes politely, leaving the ordinary exit available.

nodes.label: Key Turns
nodes.text: The master key turns in a lock you cannot see. A deeper seam opens along the passage wall.

nodes.label: Trade Accepted
nodes.text: The room accepts your attention as payment. "Ask," it says, and every lamp bends toward you.

nodes.label: Trade Refused
nodes.text: "Too little noticed," the room whispers. The alcove remains open, but its patience has cooled.

nodes.label: Narrow Escape
text: You squeeze through the dark passage and emerge in a locked courtyard with scraped hands and a racing heart.
You escaped, but some part of the room keeps ticking in your memory, waiting for the answer you did not find.

nodes.label: Archivist Wall
nodes.text: A panel slides aside, revealing writing layered over writing. Some of it is blueprint. Some of it is apology.

nodes.label: True Exit
nodes.text: "The true exit is not beyond the first door," the room says. "It is below the floor, past the service crawl, where builders fled."

nodes.label: Room Name
nodes.text: "I was named Asterion," the room says. "A maze made small enough to fit one frightened person at a time."

nodes.label: Deeper Choice
nodes.text: {{learnedTrueExit:The service crawl is no longer just a map mark; it is the real path. }}{{learnedRoomName:Asterion waits for what you will do with its name. }}

nodes.label: Hidden Seam
nodes.text: The master key points toward the chalked hatch and the red line on the ink map. The ordinary exit suddenly feels like a side door.

nodes.label: Last Notes
nodes.text: You copy three lines from the wall before they fade: Asterion, service crawl, builders fled.

nodes.label: Floor Hatch
nodes.text: The chalked hatch waits in the marble. {{restoredPower:Gold light leaks through the seam. }}The seam feels colder than the marble around it.

nodes.label: Below Hatch
nodes.text: The hatch opens on a ladder ⬆️ and a breath of old machine air. The state of the room matters now.

nodes.label: Below Forever
text: You descend before the room is powered. The hatch closes above you, and the ladder withdraws into the dark.
The ticking water continues overhead, counting for someone else now.

nodes.label: Out of Time
text: The final brass number becomes zero. Every alcove closes at once.
The room does not kill you. It simply stops being a puzzle and becomes a cell.

nodes.label: Service Crawl
nodes.text: Below the hatch, a crawlspace runs beneath the whole room. Warm cables pulse ⚡ along one wall, and a dead fuse box waits ahead.

nodes.label: Warm Cable
nodes.text: The cable leads toward the exit wall, not away from it. The ink map was honest about the hidden route.

nodes.label: Spare Fuse
nodes.text: You take a ceramic fuse from a cracked holder. It is old, but the filament inside is intact.

nodes.label: Fuse Box
nodes.text: The fuse box is labeled emergency release. A plaque beneath it has been scratched nearly blank.

nodes.label: Fuse Replaced
nodes.text: The spare fuse locks in. Power hums through the crawlspace, and dust jumps from every cable.

nodes.label: Builder Plaque
nodes.text: You decipher the scratched plaque: Mirror proves sight. Bell proves order. Water proves patience. Name proves mercy.

nodes.label: Tight Crawl
nodes.text: The crawlspace narrows. It checks your accumulated tension as much as your courage.

nodes.label: Crawl Collapse
nodes.text: A bracket snaps behind you. You scramble forward, but the delay costs the last of the room's patience.

nodes.label: Narrow Stair
nodes.text: The crawlspace opens onto a steep maintenance stair. Cool air spills down from somewhere beyond the original exit wall.

nodes.label: Map Route
nodes.text: The red line on the map matches the stair exactly. You avoid two dead turns and one floor plate that probably bites.

nodes.label: Air Guess
nodes.text: You follow the cool air and find the stair by instinct. It works, but your nerves scrape thin in the dark.

nodes.label: Service Door
nodes.text: At the top of the stair is a small service door with no handle. It has a mouth-shaped keyhole.

nodes.label: Mouth Opens
nodes.text: The mouth-shaped keyhole repeats the motto in your own voice, then opens wide enough for the master key.

nodes.label: Final Latch
nodes.text: The last latch is old builder work, rougher than the quest room above. It wants both authority and understanding.

nodes.label: Last Choice
nodes.text: The latch opens to a final chamber no larger than a closet. Asterion's voice waits in the dark.

nodes.label: Room Remembers
nodes.text: The final chamber holds a single brass heart 💛. It beats in time with every puzzle you solved above.

nodes.label: Answer Room
nodes.text: "I can keep testing people," Asterion says, "or I can become a door and be done."

nodes.label: Keeper Promise
nodes.text: You promise to send seekers, not prisoners. The brass heart accepts the distinction and slows to a calmer rhythm.

nodes.label: Room Freed
nodes.text: You tell Asterion no room should need fear to prove attention. The brass heart cracks, and warm daylight leaks through.

nodes.label: Master Exit
text: {{keeperPromise:Asterion remains behind you, changed from trap to trial. }}{{roomFreed:Asterion dissolves into light, leaving only an open doorway. }}
You step out through the true master exit, carrying not just the route, but the room's name.
